children: Gold prices collectively declined on Tuesday, September 22, according to Dahab Masr data at 2:42 PM.
The 24-karat price amounted to EGP 7,186.82 for purchase and EGP 7,112.73 for sale.
Meanwhile, the 21-karat gold registered EGP 6,289.1 for buying and EGP 6,224.26 for selling.
The 18-karat was priced at EGP 5,390.66 for buying and EGP 5,335.08 for selling.
A gold coin fell to EGP 51,312 for purchase and EGP 50,794.08 for sale.
Globally, the international ounce reached $4,320.4 for buying and $4,319.9 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt record collective drop on September 22
